items.title: Orrin Keepnews interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: Bobby Timmons was of course the Adderley’s, this band’s first piano player.

ctx.x: You had a small anecdote, I don’t know if you want to mention the person’s name again, that you said something about Nat chasing some piano player down the street.

Oh no that’s a lovely story. Bobby Timmons was of course the Adderley’s, this band’s first piano player. And Cannon had been kind of a little unhappy about circumstances, he really wanted to have Bobby in the band but it meant in effect stealing him away from Art Blakey, you know the year before Bobby had wrote “Moanin’” which had been a great hit for Blakey, and after a while Bobby for one reason or another decided to go back to Blakey. And Cannon’s idea of filling the vacant chair was this really wonderful…
did, and actually that relieved the tension a lot. But it’s a story worth remembering. I don’t think Barry will object to it, and I understand exactly what he was doing.
